##### Project general facts

Najd Six by Reportage Properties is an exceptional residential development offering a perfect combination of modern design, comfort, and elegant living. The project features 75 beautifully designed villas with 3 and 5 bedrooms, spacious layouts, private outdoor areas, and stunning architecture that creates a truly welcoming atmosphere.

Residents can enjoy an impressive range of premium amenities, including a swimming pool, jacuzzi, gym, sauna, padel and basketball courts, and beautiful green spaces. The development also offers an outdoor cinema, clubhouse, children's play area, and indoor parking, creating an ideal environment for relaxation, entertainment, and an active lifestyle.

Each villa is thoughtfully designed with stylish interiors, high-quality finishes, fully finished bathrooms, and modern kitchens with fitted cabinets. Private gardens, rooftop BBQ areas, outdoor terraces, private elevators, air conditioning, and smart access systems provide outstanding comfort, convenience, and a luxurious living experience.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Aarid is a residential district in northern Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, known for its spacious plots and calm neighbourhood character. The district is framed by King Salman Road to the south, King Fahd Road to the west and Abu Bakr Al Siddiq Road to the east, placing it within easy reach of the main growth corridors of the city. Key destinations in the area include Al Yamamah University, King Abdulaziz Grand Park and King Salman Stadium.

The surrounding road network connects the district with The Avenues Riyadh, King Khalid International Airport and the Riyadh Expo site. Schools, mosques, local shops and healthcare services support daily life, while cafés, restaurants and rest houses add leisure options within the neighbourhood.

Northern Riyadh attracts steady interest from families seeking larger homes in established residential districts. Al Aarid combines this family appeal with proximity to major infrastructure, sports and cultural venues, positioning the area for long-term residential demand.
